name: Sunset
source:
What started off as a normal movie night slowly spirals as you are put through your most horrifying experience yet. Will you be able to escape back to your friends or will the darkness consume you?

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/rlu7g7/comment/hpi5x2l/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
原本再寻常不过的电影之夜逐渐失控，将你一步步拖入迄今最为骇人的恐怖经历之中。你能否逃出生天、回到朋友们身边，还是会被黑暗彻底吞噬？

[摘自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/rlu7g7/comment/hpi5x2l/]Reddit[/url]]
